title: executive-daily-priorities-ravi-2026-03-05
body:
2026-03-05 - Daily scratchpad (Ravi)

Top 3 priorities (this week)
- Finalize Dedicated capacity SLA language with legal + sales (goal: ship commit doc by Fri 3/06). TODO: review legal edits (Sofia) by 3/05 EOD.
- Approve Private deployment onboarding checklist for enterprise pilot (Elena to confirm infra runbook).
- Quick sweep on Optimize recommendations feature spec — need sign-off to start eng spike.

Today — meetings and prep
- 09:00 1:1 with CTO (30m) — topics: runtime perf anomalies (p99 spikes), hiring plan for infra, Dedicated capacity backlog. Prep: bring p99 chart + top 3 root causes.
- 11:00 Exec leadership sync (60m) — high level: GTM targets, runway, enterprise pipeline health. Action: call out Dedicated contract with ACME as pilot.
- 14:00 Customer call (ACME security review) — bring Private deployment KMS/HSM notes and audit timeline.
- 16:00 Product review: Optimize beta metrics (latency vs cost) — be ready with two fallback plans if regressions appear.

Follow-ups & action items
- Sofia: get redlined SLA doc from Legal, share diff by EOD (assigned 3/04).
- Elena: confirm on-prem package delivery date and remove blockers from infra (owner: Elena, due 3/06).
- Product: small UX ask for Console rollout controls — add canary toggle + immediate rollback. PR link in linked_artifacts.
- Sales: lock ACME pilot MOU by 3/07, coordinate with Solutions Eng for onboarding window.

Notes / quick thoughts (stream-of-consciousness)
- Consider adding a "cost guardrail" in API: daily spend cap per api-key for Hosted customers (low-friction). Worth sketching mock in Console.
- Observability: token-level traces are great, but need easier surface for customers to map tokens -> prompt templates. Ask observability team for a 1-pager.
- Risk: if we expand Dedicated in region-eu-west without capacity reservations, might lose SLA promises. Confirm capacity reservation ops.

Blockers
- Legal signoff on Dedicated SLA (holding MOU).
- Infra: KV cache eviction bug affecting multi-tenant throughput under simulated burst (SRE investigating).

Decisions to make (today/this week)
- Whether to permit early access to new quantized model variants in Hosted w/ explicit quality warning (tradeoff: cost reduction vs potential regressions).
- Rollout plan for Optimize: phased vs big-bang. Prefer phased with canary metrics.

Later agenda items
- Draft keynote blurb for upcoming conferences (deadline 3/20).
- Headcount: finalize two IC hires for serving-runtime (sre + perf engineer).

Quick reminders
- Slack: drop a thread in #eng-serving-runtime about p99 spikes and invite root-cause volunteers.
- Send short update to Board packet about Dedicated traction (1 slide).

Unresolved questions
- What is the expected SLA uplift required by top 3 enterprise prospects? (Need sales input)
- Can we compress onboarding timeline for Private by 2 weeks without increasing ops headcount?

End of notes.
summary: Exec daily priorities + meeting prep: SLA signoff, Private onboarding, Optimize spec review; follow-ups assigned; blockers noted.
